audit_name: Track 2, Step 3.3.1: Independent CPU Feasibility Pilot Acceptance Audit

discrepancies_and_reconciliation.item: Transformer Layer Count in Step 3.3 Text
discrepancies_and_reconciliation.impact: Non-critical descriptive typo; does not alter the fact that the full 141.9M parameter checkpoint was executed.

discrepancies_and_reconciliation.reconciliation: 8.29 hours is derived strictly from steady-state throughput (0.873 samples/sec). Using overall pilot average throughput (0.709 samples/sec) yields 10.21 hours. Both estimates are idealized bounds that exclude validation loops, data loading I/O, checkpointing, and thermal throttling.
discrepancies_and_reconciliation.impact: Clarified arithmetic boundaries for operational planning.

discrepancies_and_reconciliation.item: Total Elapsed Time vs Step Time Sum
discrepancies_and_reconciliation.claimed: 6.83 seconds elapsed time vs sum of step times 4.23 seconds
discrepancies_and_reconciliation.reconciliation: The remaining 2.60 seconds accounted for process startup, model load (0.34s), tokenizer load (0.17s), and PyTorch JIT/library initialization.

binary_classification.rationale: CPU tensor execution and memory stability are verified for batch size 1. Feasible for small pilots, evaluation runs, or linear probing, but multi-epoch training of all 26,054 examples requires GPU or bounded subsets due to 8.3-10.2 hr/epoch run time.

three_class_nli.rationale: Requires separate 3-class classification head (num_labels=3), premise-hypothesis tokenization, and separate bounded pilot.

span_extraction.rationale: Requires token-level classification head (DebertaV2ForTokenClassification) and resolution of character-to-subword alignment gap.

g3_readiness.rationale: Missing 5-outcome supervision must be resolved before model training can be conceptualized.

generative_reasoning.rationale: Encoder classification architecture cannot perform autoregressive generative text reasoning.
